newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent ends untraded, NYMEX slightly lower on API.
newsitem.headline: Brent ends untraded, NYMEX slightly lower on API.

text.p: September Brent crude futures were untraded in Asia on Wednesday while NYMEX crude edged down slightly.
September Brent was settled at $18.20 per barrel on SIMEX after last quotes were indicated at $18.17/$18.20, for an indicative loss of two cents from London overnight.
NYMEX September futures, trading on ACCESS, were last traded at 0915 GMT at $19.45 per barrel, down three cents from New York.

API data overnight was considered bullish for the overall oil complex because of continued signs of strong demand for gasoline, but traders said the slight NYMEX weakness may have been the result of a keener focus on an unexpected build in crude stocks.
